description.html: HabiStat Tortoise Food Fruit & Flower in the large pack is an economical choice for owners who use this food regularly or keep several tortoises. This dry pelleted food is enriched with dried fruit and flowers, giving tortoises a varied, tasty meal that mimics their natural diet. A bigger jar means you will have enough food for a longer period, without the need to rebuy often.

The formula is designed to meet the nutritional needs of tortoises - high fiber content ensures healthy digestion, a low protein level suits tortoise metabolism, and a rich calcium and vitamin D3 content supports proper development of the shell and skeleton. The pellets are made from all-natural ingredients, with no artificial colors, flavors or preservatives, which makes this food safe for everyday use.

Before feeding, soak the desired amount of pellets in warm water for a few minutes until they soften. Softened pellets are easier to eat and help keep the tortoise hydrated. This food is suitable for European tortoises, Russian tortoises and most other tortoise species. HabiStat is a renowned British brand known for the quality of its reptile products. A small pack is also available for those who want to try this flavor first.
